question.prompt: Consider the following four transformations: (1) \(a(a+1)=a^2+a\); (2) \(a^2-1=(a+1)(a-1)\); (3) \(a^2+2a+1=a(a+2)+1\); (4) \(2a^2-2a=2a(a-1)\). How many are factorizations? (Enter a number.)

solutions.explanation: (2) and (4) rewrite polynomials as products of polynomial expressions, so they are factorizations. (1) is polynomial multiplication, and the right-hand side of (3) is not in product form.
solutions.title: Apply the definition to each transformation
